system.description:
A developed and terrible form of Dread Gaze. You may not kill with a look, but you come close - freezing even another vampire in mind-numbing terror.

Make eye contact, then a Social Challenge against the target (retest Leadership). On a success they are reduced to a gibbering, panic-stricken wreck. The effect lasts as long as you remain in the same room, or until sunrise; if you leave the room the subject stays paralyzed for the rest of the scene, then slowly recovers. If the subject's life is directly threatened, they may attempt a Static Mental Challenge to snap out of it; success frees them, but failure plunges them into continuous Rötschreck for the rest of the night.
system.duration: As long as you remain present, or until sunrise
